title: Create: Physics And Aeronautics
description: A Create modpack centered around physics, roads, and vehicles, featuring planes, cars, trucks, and more.
body:
![Header](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/6c4ec7b84e9027ac6e4d3fc1b6806a8e33107bc2.png)

Also check out Create: Aeronautics, the core mod this pack is built around.

--- ## Trailer Sneak Peek

This is only a sneak peek of the trailer, not the full trailer.

--- ## About Create: Phys & Aeronautics is a modpack built around the mod **Create: Aeronautics**, combining Create-style engineering with a performance-focused setup. You can build things like planes, cars, machines, entire factories, and lots of other cool stuff. It originally started as a lightweight “Lite” pack for lower-end PCs, but evolved into a more complete gameplay experience instead of just a trimmed-down version. > **Note:** This modpack is made for **NeoForge 1.21.1** and will not work on other Minecraft versions or mod loaders such as Fabric. --- ## Contact If you need help, want to give feedback, or just hang out: * **Discord (preferred):** Join the server using the button above * **Direct contact:** `arthurbao12` --- ## How to install (Modrinth) 1. Download the modpack from this page. 2. Create a new instance in your launcher. 3. Import the modpack. 4. Launch and play. --- ## Troubleshooting If this prompt appears during loading: ![Error](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/d9e81b07199e5b43cdb69f7187c22bc9e6c49ac4.png) Click **Yes**, then restart the game. **If the game crashes on startup:** * Remove the mod `Simple Custom Early Loading Screen` * Delete the `fml.toml` file inside the `config` folder **If the game crashes on startup with a different error:** * Try using Java 21 if you aren't already. Other Java versions (newer or older) may cause issues with this modpack. ---
